source.caption: What selected mathematical criticism resources evaluate and what supports their references. Counts refer to different units. BugBank connects source assertions to concrete witnesses and Lean certificates, with version-linked human review for the 147-dossier human-approved core; the localization score evaluates the selected line.

rows.resource_and_scale: Co-PEER / BugBank / human-approved core: 147 dossiers; 100 primary texts
rows.evaluation_target: Accepted error line; Hit@1 and Hit@3
rows.reference_evidence: Concrete witnesses and selected Lean proofs; all core dossiers have all-YES human judgments on the three dossier criteria, with recorded version continuity. Exact line-label review is recorded separately.

rows.evaluation_target: First erroneous step or no error
rows.reference_evidence: Expert reference labels. The evaluated system generates local Lean evidence and checks semantic alignment.
Author correction history; LLM location matching.

rows.evaluation_target: Truth judgments and reasoning with examples
rows.reference_evidence: Textbook rationales and author checks; model evaluation includes a 100-output human check.

rows.evaluation_target: Construct an admissible input on which a program fails
rows.reference_evidence: Reference implementations and input-constraint validators check generated counterexamples.

rows.evaluation_target: First erroneous step or no error
